offence_note: Two break and enters with theft, possession of stolen property; CSO breach
sentence_quote: I sentence Ms. Isaac to prison for six months on Count 1, 18 months on Count 2, and 18 months on Count 3, all sentences to be concurrent with each other.
note: Prior conditional sentence terminated; remaining 15 days to run consecutively; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Sexual offences against three young victims in position of trust
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed and the sentence is increased to four-and-a-half-years imprisonment concurrent on all charges.
note: Crown appeal; original sentence not shown.

offence_note: Six sexual assaults on strangers with weapons, confinement and robbery
sentence_quote: We are satisfied that the sentence of six years in addition to the three and one-half years of pre-sentence custody was fit.
note: Total effective 13 years; 3.5 years custody credited two for one; conviction appeal also dismissed.

offence_note: Trafficking and possession for trafficking fentanyl and heroin
sentence_quote: the trial judge imposed a sentence that was fit in the circumstances.
note: Global six years less credit and Downes credit gives 5y 8m; court mentions few mitigating factors unspecified.

offence_note: Marijuana production and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: I would grant leave and allow the appeal to the extent of deleting the probation order.
note: Probation deleted on appeal; wife co-accused received 12 months conditional sentence at trial, not before court.

offence_note: Occupational health and safety offences causing worker death
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the fines of $250,000 are restored with respect to the two convictions that survived the conviction appeal
note: Corporate offender; Crown appeal restoring fines of $250,000 on two counts.

sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed and the sentence is reduced to 6 months less one day.
note: Reduced on consent for immigration consequences; offences not stated; whether custodial not stated.

offence_note: Offences not identified; serious with severe victim consequences
sentence_quote: we grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal, maintain the sentence as imposed but with credit for twenty-three months for pre-trial custody for a net sentence of twenty-five months.
note: Global four years maintained; credit added; offences not stated.

sentence_quote: life imprisonment is the sentence imposed by the Court.

offence_note: Sexual assault of 11 year old step-son
sentence_quote: the sentence of this Court is two years in the Federal Institution together with a three year period of Probation.

offence_note: Offences not shown; restitution order challenged
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the appeal is allowed, and the amount of the restitution order pertaining to Global Payments is reduced to the sum of $43,240.
note: Only restitution varied; rest of sentence not shown; other restitution amounts may exist.

offence_note: Break and enter of dwelling; non-consensual sharing of intimate images
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence Mr. Scarfe to a suspended sentence on the break and entry and two years probation, and a four-month conditional sentence for the sharing of intimate images, with two years probation to be served concurrently
note: Suspended sentence on break and enter; s.109 order for 10 years.
